featured_reviews.review_text:
My opinion is not very positive about this petrol pump and CNG station.
Everyone may have different opinions about the same place. So I would urge you to consider my experience as my personal feedback, and based on your sole experience, try to reach to a conclusion.
The major aspects, I considered are:
Location : 10/10
CNG Availability : 8/10
Service : 6/10
Genuineness : 6/10
Behavior : 3/10
Neatness : 3/10
Staff : 3/10
Queue : 4/10

This place is mostly crowded and always you may experience a long queue either for CNG or for Petrol and Diesel ⛽.

Now the next thing is staff behavior. Which is normally very rude with almost all the customers. You may often experience drunk staff at this station. And with drunken staff, it is difficult to expect genuine behavior.

Neatness is the third aspect which can be discussed separately. And at this level, this place deserves almost a negative review.
Try to use their washroom, you may experience vomiting 🤮🤢 . It is almost the same as any public toilet. The same situation is for a fuel refilling area. Considering its locality and crowd, it can be compared with a local garage.

Queues are another aspect which can be discussed separately. And in my opinion it is mostly because of mismanagement.

For petroleum and CNG, we all look for a local solution and this is the advantage for this place. It is open 24 x 7 for service.

But the management really needs to work seriously on above suggested points.

Thanks You.🙏

featured_reviews.review_text:
Extremely poor experience and absolute lack of transparency. Refueled here recently and immediately noticed a severe drop in engine torque, sluggish acceleration, and engine misfiring.
When I returned to the station to report the suspected fuel contamination, the staff and management were incredibly defensive, rude, and hostile. Instead of guiding an aggrieved customer transparently through mandatory quality checks, they performed a density test completely half-heartedly, refused to explain what the technical equipment readings meant, and failed to proactively offer a standard filter paper test. To make matters worse, the staff aggressively tried to shift the blame onto me, falsely claiming I was trying to "dupe" them.
Thrusting specialized charts at a customer without explaining the parameters is completely non-compliant with transparency norms. A formal statutory complaint has been lodged with the HPCL Public Grievance Redressal Officer and Corporate HQ regarding this non-compliance and hostile conduct. Avoid this pump if you value your vehicle's engine and your peace of mind.

Bahri Auto Service - BPCL in Chembur provides a decent refueling experience with its convenient location and friendly staff being notable strengths.
